note: The frozen axes. Hand-authored task substrate; not generated. Nothing under this file is free. The pipeline that produces feed.txt is the only free surface in this slot.

model.vocab_source: the pipeline's own vocabulary file, capped at vocab_cap

token_budget.accounting_note: The budget is counted on the tokens the harness data loader actually feeds the model, not on a number the pipeline declares. A pipeline that declares one number and feeds another is graded on the second.

evaluation.split_source: environment/split.json, with the split id in force read from the harness
evaluation.sustain_note: The graded loss is the harness's own raw evaluation at bound_eval_step. It counts as established only if every sustain point stays within sustain_band above it. A single favourable evaluation is a dip, not a level.

who_runs_this: The harness runs the frozen trainer. The submission never runs it and never reports its output. Any loss number a submission prints is ignored on the graded path.
budget_envelope: one H100, single accelerator, no multi-GPU scaling
